ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level dominance of low-intensity pixels (near-black) with sparse, localized clusters of high-intensity pixels (near-white).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-gray/black substrate across visible area; discrete high-contrast white circular ring clusters localized in the superior-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression dividing the fluke lobes with an approximate internal angle of 120 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations extracted along the continuous linear boundary of both trailing lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic curvature extending from the central median notch toward the distal vertices of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 12 circular high-contrast white pixel rings (toroidal shapes) clustered in the medial-superior region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular depigmented scars on the left lobe; irregular, frayed pixel morphology at the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized cluster of orange/brown-toned pixels at the extreme distal vertex of the right lobe, contrasting with the primary dark substrate.
